_comment: A/B for the owner: phase2 + fast_evaluate (the operator relay account now has evaluate enabled; the hvm rig has it locally). Everything else identical to toolset.phase2.json — regenerate from it, do not edit by hand. Never add evaluate to no-cdp.

describe.fast_snapshot: Read the current page: interactive elements (text, label, live value, coords) plus readable content blocks; `fillable:N` counts the empty fields on the view and when N ≥ 2 they go in ONE fast_fill {fields} (or one fast_batch), never one call per field. A result that starts with truncated:true is partial — call again with full:true (or limit:N) before relying on it; pass overlay:true when an open menu's options are missing; avoid viewport:true (it hides every control below the fold).
describe.fast_text: Return the page's innerText (or one element's via selector; html:true for outerHTML) — the exact source for data extraction such as tables and lists. truncated:true (first field) means more text exists: call again with a larger maxLen or a narrower selector.
describe.fast_click: Click the element whose text/label/placeholder matches `text` (narrow with role — a tag name like "a" or "button" works too — or index = the N-th match in document order, NOT a snapshot id; offscreen matches are scrolled into view); the result leads with url/urlChanged/focused and a fresh snapshot, so do not call fast_snapshot right after. On a miss nothing was clicked: retry with a name from `candidates`/`available`/`matches` (each says its real role/tag and whether it is offscreen and in which section), a `hint` naming fast_select_option means the target is a dropdown — use that instead, and if settling:true the page was still loading — fast_wait for the target text first.
describe.fast_click_xy: Trusted click at viewport CSS coordinates x,y; returns no snapshot. Only when fast_click cannot match the element (canvas, cross-origin iframe).
describe.fast_fill: Set fields by label/placeholder/name: ONE field with {match, value} or a WHOLE FORM with fields:{label: value | {value, index, section}} (native selects included) — a form with 2+ inputs is always one fast_fill {fields} or one fast_batch, never field-by-field; offscreen fields are scrolled into view. The result leads with verified + the live `value` (per field under `fields` in the form case) — report `value`, not what you sent; a miss lists `candidates`, `hiddenMatches`, `offscreenMatches` (with section) and a `hint` — retry with one of those names, pass section:/index:, or use fast_select_option when the hint names a dropdown.
describe.fast_select_option: Choose `option` in the dropdown named `field` (its label, placeholder, or the heading above it; native, react-select, Angular, ARIA); the result leads with verified, picked, `value` (what the control shows now) and `field` (which dropdown it acted on) — check both before reporting. On a miss retry with a name from `candidates`; use selections:{field:option} to set several in one call.
describe.fast_key_press: Press `key` (Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown...) on the focused element; returns the target, url/urlChanged and a fresh settled snapshot so you can see what the key did.
describe.fast_scroll: Scroll the page or the nearest scroll container: to:"top"|"bottom"|"50%" or pixels (negative = up). Returns a fresh snapshot.
describe.fast_wait: Wait until `text` appears (case-insensitive substring — use two or more words), or `selector` matches a visible element, or with networkIdle:true (alone) until requests settle; with text + networkIdle the text is the signal and the result reports networkIdle/pending instead of timing out. Use after an action that triggers async loading; returns the matched element and a snapshot, emptyContainer:true when only a stale/empty container matched (the view has not rendered), or the visible headings on timeout.
describe.fast_tab: Open `url` in a new tab and focus it.
describe.fast_nav: Go to `url` in the current tab and wait for the load (waitMs, default 10s).
describe.fast_batch: Run several steps in one round-trip (actions:[{name,args}]) — every step runs even if one misses, and the result leads with a summary line ("5/6 steps ok; step 3 (fast_fill \"Ocean\") missed: …") plus per-step verified state or the miss with candidates; only the last step returns a snapshot. Use it whenever the next steps are already known — a whole form (fast_fill {fields}, fast_select_option, fast_key_press, fast_click) is ONE batch; a conditional step {ifFound:"text or css selector", then:[…], else:[…]} branches inside the batch without a model turn.
describe.report_done: Finish the task: result = the outcome in at most 3 short sentences that quote names, numbers and field values EXACTLY as the page shows them (no abbreviations, rounding or paraphrase); evidence = ONE short quote copied verbatim from your last fast_snapshot/fast_text result plus its URL. Refused unless a read followed your last action and the evidence quote matches a tool result.
describe.fast_evaluate: Run a JS function (`fn`, optional `args`) in the page for READ-ONLY queries of the DOM (a table to rows, a field value, element counts); never touch cookies, storage or send requests, and prefer fast_text when plain text will do. Returns the function's JSON result.
